diagnosis: The current Dashboard projects collection is admitted only if the host-observed day lies in the selected period. The W16 run observed2026-11-14 but the driver selected2027 for the current project snapshot; this is a sufficient deterministic source-unavailable cause.

Both name and milestones are allowed public project fields and are present in the real project projection. The authenticated admin actor has the Portfolio Dashboard page; neither fields nor visibility need widening.
The CAPEX record is explicitly year2027; its real source scope requires the2027 period. It must not be relabelled as the current observation year merely to match the project.

The C06 pmo-capex catalogue validates exact endpoint types, installation/project identity and ref hashes. Its current source authorizer resolves each real issued reference independently; it does not require their period to equal the decision horizon.

The driver also used context.ui around services.dispatch for relation_read and answer_read. That wrapper pre-consumes UI admission; the dispatcher validates it again and correctly denies a second consumption. Both calls now use the shared real single-use dispatch helper.
changes: Projects and the homonymous outside-case negative use the UTC calendar year of context.at. CAPEX, Planner, decision horizon, thread/selection periods and all raw domain fields retain2027.
Separate issuer failures identify project versus CAPEX. Ten new assertions verify actual endpoint identities/surfaces/types/periods; all70 previous expect lines remain.
One marker reports public endpoint refs/fields/periods and separates current observation from financial horizon. It records no inference/GNATIVE acceptance.
Relation and answer operations use dispatchWp12Ui. Direct business source issuers continue to use context.ui; no private lease or serialized binding is created.
